prompt:
Act as an expert full-stack developer and create a production-ready, beautiful private community platform clone of Circle using Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and PostgreSQL (via Drizzle ORM). The application must feature a breathtaking, modern user interface utilizing glassmorphism, smooth micro-animations (using Framer Motion), and a meticulously crafted design system using rich, harmonious colors and premium typography (like Inter or Outfit). The UI must feel incredibly premium, responsive, and alive.

Core Features & Functionality:
1. Spaces & Threads: Implement 'Spaces' (categories) where users can create rich-text threads and replies. Threads should support Markdown, image uploads, and newest-activity-first sorting. Render threads beautifully with clear typography and spacing.
2. Magic-link Authentication: A frictionless login experience. Members enter their email (must be on an invite list) and receive a secure, short-lived magic link via Resend. No passwords, no public self-signup.
3. Member Profiles & Directory: Beautiful profile pages showing member name, rounded avatar (resized and optimized), joined date, and contribution count. A directory view to see all members in the community.
4. Smart Notifications: Email notifications for immediate replies to user threads, plus an automated daily digest of new community activity. Include per-member mute toggles and preferences.
5. Admin/Moderator Controls: A sophisticated admin view to manage the community. Abilities include removing members, deleting violating posts, and managing space settings.

Technical Architecture & Best Practices:
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Use shadcn/ui for accessible, highly polished foundation components, heavily customized for a premium look.
- Backend & DB: Next.js Route Handlers with strict Zod validation. PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM.
- Authentication: Secure magic link authentication using NextAuth.js or Supabase Auth.
- SEO & Performance: Implement automatic meta tags, semantic HTML5, localized loading states, and flawless error boundaries.

Implementation Requirements:
Start from an empty repository and build the complete working project. Store all data locally by default and ensure straightforward export. Put all secrets in `.env` and ship a `.env.example`. Include comprehensive error handling and input validation.

Deliverables:
Provide the full, deployable codebase. Include a detailed `README.md` covering setup, architecture, database migrations, and local testing instructions. Write focused unit tests for the core data model. Deliberately exclude: payments, complex courses, live events, and mobile apps. Focus relentlessly on a flawless community discussion experience.
